description:
Live exchange collapse keeps listening and stays closed across handoffs. The voice call is faked. In an eval, window.liveEmit(event) delivers event from Live (e.g. window.liveEmit({type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "Hello ", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 400})); emit each event in its own eval, in the order given. window.liveSpeak(id, speech) speaks and delegates: it emits {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: speech, start_ms: 0, end_ms: 900} and then {type: "session.delegation.created", offset_ms: 900, delegation: {id, target: "client"}}. window.liveNotes() returns the JSON of everything Shelley sent to Live. window.__voiceTracksStopped counts the microphone tracks stopped. "Start the call" means: click data-testid "live-call-header"; data-testid "live-bar" should contain "On call". "The exchange" is data-testid "live-exchange". "The message X" is the [data-testid="message"] elements whose text contains X (has_text; it collapses whitespace, so a line break is a space). Text checks on messages and the exchange compare whitespace-collapsed text: eval el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, " ").includes(...) with expect true (or false for "not contain"), on every matching element. "The toggle" is data-testid "live-exchange-toggle" (the exchange's summary); "the region" is the exchange's [role="region"][aria-label="Live exchange transcript"]. Call "snapshot" saves the conversation as the server has it; call "unchanged" says whether it is still exactly the same. Perform the steps in order.
1. Navigate to /c/collapse and start the call. Call "snapshot".
2. Emit {type: "session.input_transcript.delta", delta: "echo: collapse me", start_ms: 0, end_ms: 1000}.
3. Click the toggle. The exchange's JS property open should be false (eval, expect false), and the region should be hidden.
4. Emit {type: "session.output_transcript.delta", delta: "Still listening.", start_ms: 1100, end_ms: 1800}. data-testid "live-bar" should contain "On call". Call "unchanged" should return exactly "true".
5. Emit {type: "session.delegation.created", offset_ms: 1800, delegation: {id: "collapsed", target: "client"}}. The message "Spoken request: echo: collapse me" should contain "LIVE: Still listening.". The exchange should become hidden.
6. Emit {type: "session.output_transcript.delta", delta: "More words while collapsed. ".repeat(80), start_ms: 2000, end_ms: 12000}. The exchange should become visible, its open property still false, and the region hidden.
7. Focus the toggle (one-shot eval calling its focus()) and press Space. The region should become visible and contain "More words while collapsed.". Its distance from the bottom (scrollHeight - clientHeight - scrollTop) should come to be at most 1.
8. Click data-testid "live-stop".

steps.expression: window.liveEmit({type: 'session.input_transcript.delta', delta: 'echo: collapse me', start_ms: 0, end_ms: 1000})

Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="message"]')).filter(el => el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').includes('Spoken request: echo: collapse me')).every(el => el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').includes('LIVE: Still listening.'))
window.liveEmit({type: 'session.output_transcript.delta', delta: 'More words while collapsed. '.repeat(80), start_ms: 2000, end_ms: 12000})

(function(){ var el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="live-exchange"] [role="region"][aria-label="Live exchange transcript"]'); return el.scrollHeight - el.clientHeight - el.scrollTop <= 1; })()
